source_checks.quote: We confirmed the well-known association with DTC of the 9q22.31 region that includes the FOXE1 gene ( 9–12 ). In this independent and separate case–control study conducted in Germany, we replicated associations with PTC risk that we reported previously in SERPINA5 ( 21 ) and FTO ( 17 ) genes. Other candidate variants in EVPL , TICAM1 and SCARB1 previously identified ( 17 , 21 ) were also associated with PTC risk. We found several new associations between SNPs in SERPINA5 , FTO , TICAM1 and HSPA6 genes, and risk of FTC. In contrast to several studies, we did not observe associations for NKX2-1 SNPs ( 9 , 25 , 26 ).
